evidence.summary: The US Entity List gives the laboratory’s address as the Science and Technology Building of the National University of Defense Technology, the PLA’s defence technology university in Changsha, and the US Defense Department’s Section 1286 list names it a national defence science and technology key laboratory (信息系统工程国防科技重点实验室). The Commerce Department added it in December 2022 with Chinese AI chip developers it said are, or are closely tied to, government bodies that support the Chinese military and defence industry.
